source_note: Benchmark requirements are original, narrowed operationalisations inspired by the public NIST catalogue; they are not verbatim control text.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.benchmark_requirement: Accounts and privileges must correspond to currently authorised users, and access must be disabled within the organisation-defined removal period after authorisation ends.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.benchmark_requirement: Users and processes must receive only the privileges required for approved duties, and temporary elevated access must expire as authorised.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.benchmark_requirement: The system must generate records for the organisation-defined security-relevant events, including authentication and privileged administrative changes.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.benchmark_requirement: Audit records and security alerts must be reviewed at the defined frequency, with evidence of analysis and escalation where required.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.benchmark_requirement: Organisational users must be uniquely identified and authenticated using the mechanisms required for the assessed system and account class.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.benchmark_requirement: A reviewed and approved baseline must exist for the assessed system, and deployed configurations must be evaluated against the applicable baseline.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.benchmark_requirement: Security-relevant configuration settings must conform to the approved hardening standard unless a valid, scoped exception exists.

controls.title: System Backup
controls.benchmark_requirement: Required backups must complete successfully and restoration capability must be tested at the organisation-defined frequency.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.benchmark_requirement: Systems must be scanned at the defined frequency, findings must be tracked, and vulnerabilities must be remediated or formally accepted within risk-based deadlines.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.benchmark_requirement: Applicable security-relevant flaws and updates must be identified, prioritised, installed within defined timelines, and verified on the assessed asset.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.benchmark_requirement: Security incidents must be prepared for, detected, analysed, contained, eradicated, recovered from, and documented according to the response process.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.benchmark_requirement: The organisation must continuously monitor selected controls and system conditions at defined frequencies and act on identified weaknesses.
